title: <mcp-server>.json
description: One MCP server, in rbtv's format, read by rbtv and translated into each harness's own MCP server settings.

name.description: The server's name, the same as its file name without `.json`.

description.description: One line that is enough to decide whether the server is relevant.

url.description: The address of a remote server. Present only when `command` is absent.

command.description: The program that starts a local server. Present only when `url` is absent.

env.description: Variables the server receives: each key is the variable the server reads, and each value is the name of the environment variable that holds its value. Never the value itself.
